content:
Jordan L: Ivy (healthcare) needs Private POC onboarding. Must support BYOK (KMS or HSM-wrapped) and CA-signed agent certs. They want dev access in ~48h. Any immediate blockers?

Amy S: Two paths: (A) BYOK via AWS KMS + key policy granting our service principal, or (B) Redwood-managed key for fast start (requires custody addendum). I'll surface tradeoffs.

Sam R: For BYOK we need: KMS key ARN, key policy JSON, VPC + subnet list, CA-signed agent cert (PEM). If HSM: wrapped key blob (PKCS#11) + attestation doc.

Keisha P: Networking note: agent needs outbound to api.redwood-inference.internal:443 and access to model storage (S3 or presigned). If strict egress, they can provide an outbound proxy or we deploy a relay in their VPC.

Sam R: Quick copy-paste CSR instructions for them:
```
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out agent.key
openssl req -new -key agent.key -out agent.csr -subj "/CN=redwood-agent.ivy.poc/O=Ivy"
# have your CA sign agent.csr -> agent.crt
```

Amy S: Minimal JSON we ask them to paste into Console:
```
{ "customer":"Ivy","vpc_id":"vpc-0123","subnets":["subnet-a"],"kms_key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:...","agent_cert_pem":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..." }
```

security_bot: Onboard ticket created: https://internal.redwood/onboard/1981002468. Steps: receive artifacts, validate KMS access, bootstrap agent, run validation script.

Jordan L: Perfect. Amy - can you send the Redwood-managed key opt-in + pricing? Sam - please drop the validation script link. I'll confirm the 48h slot with Ivy.

Amy S: On it, will DM pricing in 15m.

Sam R: Will post script link in ~30m.

Keisha P: I'll prep the security blurb for their questionnaire (rotation cadence, escrow, attestation).

Jordan L: Thanks everyone.
